title: The Result type
hints: Look at the README's 'New syntax' (Result, ternary, flatMap, switch as a value). Each body is one expression.
Idea: divide picks failure or success with a ternary on `b == 0`; divideTwice divides once and flatMaps that success into a second divide; describe switches on success / failure.
Example on other data: `host.isEmpty ? .failure(.offline) : .success(42)` · `ping("a").flatMap { ms in ping("b") }` · `case .success(let ms): "\(ms) ms"`.
Near-answer: `divide(a, b).flatMap { divide($0, c) }`; describe: `case .success(let value): "ok \(value)"` and `case .failure(.divisionByZero): "error: division by zero"`.
